description: Prevention of LDAP injection attacks through parameterized LDAP queries, input sanitization of special characters (*, (, ), \, NUL, |, &), and use of LDAP filter escaping functions. Prevents attackers from manipulating LDAP search filters to bypass authentication, escalate privileges, or extract unauthorized directory data. Applies DN escaping for distinguished names and filter escaping for search filter values.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Requires crafted input AND LDAP filter bypass; escaping prevents filter manipulation
Prevents unauthorized directory writes and authentication bypass via filter injection
Prevents directory enumeration and unauthorized data extraction via wildcard injection

verification.method: Code review for LDAP filter escaping and parameterized queries

Zero matches — all LDAP search calls should have upstream escaping or parameterization
DN escaping present for code paths that construct distinguished names from user input
